title: Vigilon

listing.shortDescription: Vigilon workforce operations command center for physical security agencies showing field telemetry, workforce dispatch, attendance verification, patrol compliance, and financial governance
listing.fullDescription: Vigilon workforce operations command center for physical security agencies showing field telemetry, workforce dispatch, attendance verification, patrol compliance, and financial governance

features.title: Zero-trust attendance
features.description: Combine polygon geofencing, biometric liveness simulation, and cryptographic timestamps before authorizing a clock-in.

features.title: Fatigue-aware scheduling
features.description: Detect shift overlaps, overtime thresholds, and continuous-work risks before supervisors confirm assignments.

features.title: Hours-to-invoice automation
features.description: Calculate billable hours, overtime, shift differentials, payroll cost, and gross margin from verified attendance.

features.title: NFC patrol verification
features.description: Track checkpoint sequences, dwell-time requirements, missed scans, and camera-only incident documentation.

features.title: Tactical operations radar
features.description: Give dispatchers a live simulated view of officer positions, geofences, checkpoint status, and incidents.

features.title: Operations command assistant
features.description: Route common pricing, offline-operation, demo, and compliance questions through an embedded dispatch assistant.

challenge.summary: Physical security agencies were relying on paper logs, broad GPS circles, spreadsheets, and manual invoice reconciliation in a low-margin, high-liability operating environment.

points.title: Ghost shifts and buddy punching
points.description: Paper sign-in sheets and broad GPS radii could not reliably prove that the assigned guard was physically present at the post.

points.title: Scheduling and fatigue risk
points.description: Spreadsheet scheduling made overlapping shifts, unfilled posts, overtime leakage, and excessive consecutive hours easy to miss.

points.title: Invoice disputes
points.description: Clients needed proof of physical presence while finance teams spent weeks reconciling hours against paper records.

points.title: Unverified patrols
points.description: Without checkpoint and dwell-time verification, guards could rush rounds and leave high-risk areas insufficiently inspected.

solution.summary: Vigilon connects field verification, workforce dispatch, patrol execution, and financial governance in a single interactive command workflow.

points.title: Polygon and liveness authorization
points.description: A coordinate boundary check and facial-liveness state work together to authorize or block timecard creation.

points.title: Conflict-detecting shift board
points.description: The scheduler flags overlaps, fatigue violations, overtime, and open shifts while supporting reassignment and broadcast actions.

points.title: Margin-aware billing engine
points.description: Interactive inputs calculate regular, overtime, night, and holiday billing alongside payroll expense and gross margin.

points.title: Checkpoint and incident controls
points.description: NFC route execution enforces sequence and dwell time while incident reporting requires direct camera capture.

points.title: Command visibility
points.description: The radar, event log, and assistant give supervisors a shared operational view across posts and incidents.

objectives: Validate attendance with location, liveness, and timestamp signals
Reduce scheduling conflicts, overtime leakage, and fatigue violations
Turn verified hours into transparent client invoices and margin calculations
Verify patrol rounds through checkpoint sequences and dwell-time rules
Give dispatchers a unified command view for field operations and incidents

closing.clientOverview: Vigilon is designed for field security officers, dispatch supervisors, field operations directors, and finance controllers. Officers need friction-free clock-ins and offline support; dispatchers need post coverage and incident visibility; executives need reliable attendance evidence, margins, and audit-ready invoices.
closing.conclusion: Vigilon replaces disconnected logs and spreadsheets with a coherent operational command surface. Its implemented simulators demonstrate how verified attendance, fatigue-safe scheduling, patrol evidence, invoice calculations, and dispatch intelligence can work together while clearly distinguishing simulated integrations from production hardware and APIs.

results.label: Application routes
results.detail: A complete SPA spanning attendance, scheduling, billing, incidents, solutions, pricing, resources, cases, demo, contact, and security workflows.

results.label: Geofence tolerance
results.detail: The documented simulator models tight polygon validation instead of broad circular GPS check-in radii.

results.label: Core simulators
results.detail: Geofence, radar, scheduler, invoice calculator, and patrol-route engines provide interactive operational demonstrations.

results.label: Typed UI domain
results.detail: Workforce, patrol, billing, scheduling, and dispatch concepts are modeled through TypeScript domain structures and reusable components.
